subject: Rodent Control Ordinance and School Budget Adjustments
overview: The Council referred a major rodent control ordinance and a proposal for retired police officer detail work to committee, while approving a $1 million increase to the school budget following a state funding update. Members also deliberated on outdoor dining beautification, accessory dwelling units, and capital improvement funding for the high school.

items.title: Dutton Circle Sidewalks
items.summary: Approved the replacement of sidewalks on Dutton Circle following resident testimony regarding a three-year delay after utility work.

items.title: Rodent Control Ordinance
items.summary: Referred a proposed city ordinance (Paper 20-519) establishing rodent control measures and fee structures for construction and businesses to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Outdoor Dining Beautification and Accessibility
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting the administration implement beautification standards and ensure ADA compliance for temporary outdoor dining setups.

items.title: Accessory Dwelling Units
items.summary: Approved a request for the city solicitor to draft a zoning amendment authorizing accessory dwelling units to increase housing stock. A related request for an update on all pending council-requested ordinances was referred to committee.

items.title: School Budget Amendment
items.summary: Approved an increase of $1,089,537 to the FY2021 school budget following a commitment from the state to level-fund Chapter 70 aid.

items.title: Medford High School Improvement Funds
items.summary: Tabled two requests to reprogram approximately $816,000 in surplus bond proceeds for high school improvements because the Council requested a prioritized list of specific projects from the School Committee.

items.title: Black Lives Matter Banner Opinion
items.summary: The Council voted 4-3 to appeal the ruling of the chair, effectively ruling a resolution requesting a legal opinion on the placement of a Black Lives Matter banner out of order.

items.title: Retired Police Officer Details
items.summary: Referred a proposal to utilize recently retired police officers for unfilled traffic details to the Committee of the Whole and requested a draft Home Rule Petition from the administration.

items.title: Library Update and St. Raphael's Sidewalks
items.summary: Received a fundraising update on the Medford Public Library Foundation, which has raised $4.6 million, and approved a resolution for immediate sidewalk repairs at St. Raphael's Church.

items.title: Systemic Racism and Public Art Programs
items.summary: Referred resolutions to identify policies for dismantling systemic racism and to discuss a 'Percent for Art' program for municipal capital projects to the Subcommittee on Cultural Arts and History.

items.title: 2020 Census Support
items.summary: Approved a resolution urging residents to complete the 2020 Census following a federal decision to shorten the response deadline to September 30.

items.title: Election Update and Public Participation
items.summary: The City Clerk reported on early voting progress and addressed a clerical error regarding missing ballot envelopes; the Council also heard public comment regarding building department procedures for demolition delays.
